scenarios.title: Same-property reorder, cross-property move, persistence, and one-step undo
steps: Reorder alpha and beta and move one value between po_source and po_target
Use Undo and Redo without first focusing the note body
Wait for persistence and compare the final YAML while preserving the body
Repeat one guarded move while the acceptance controller changes the disposable fixture after the operation begins
expected: The editor, visible Properties view, and disk YAML converge after one host turn
Unrelated properties, comments, quoting, newline semantics, and body text remain intact
Touch and desktop interaction retain native actions, and the externally changed fixture fails closed without overwriting either version

scenarios.title: Grouped value suggestions, custom presets, frequency, and confirmed commits
steps: Open Value Suggestions.md and enable value suggestion management in the four-tab settings surface
Use the acceptance provider to prepare grouped behaviors: status uses Custom candidates with planned/draft pinned and archived/deferred bottom, while priority uses Selection frequency

Verify the Value suggestions page shows mutually exclusive behavior groups, supports property-key choices without eager duplicate membership, and shows the Custom status editor with pinned, normal, and bottom sections

Open status candidates and verify planned and deferred remain selectable even though no fixture note previously contains them; select one through the visible candidate UI and verify the committed YAML

Select priority candidates in a controlled order, wait for Metadata Cache confirmation, and verify Selection frequency changes only after confirmed commits while Note count remains a different ordering source
Check that ordinary context menus retain their actions and disabling enhancement restores native behavior

Use the acceptance provider to prepare status No suggestions, type a value into status, and confirm manual typing remains available; press Enter and Tab without intentionally selecting a candidate and confirm neither commits a suppressed candidate; restore the grouped behaviors and confirm suggestions return
expected: General, Value order, Key suggestions and Value suggestions remain accessible at desktop and mobile widths
Each exact property key has at most one active behavior; moving a key changes its group rather than duplicating it
Custom status candidates use pinned + normal + bottom ordering and explicit preset-only values can be selected without first appearing in another note
A selected preset commits through the Properties editor and only a Metadata Cache-confirmed selection advances device-local Selection frequency
Selection frequency and Markdown note count remain distinct; ordinary context-menu actions and existing value dragging remain usable
No suggestions suppresses candidates only: manual typing remains available, unmodified Enter/Tab does not select a suppressed candidate, and restoring the grouped behavior restores suggestions

scenarios.title: Property-type grouped key suggestions, keyboard order, and host restoration
steps: Open Key Suggestions.md, use the acceptance provider to prepare key type grouping, and start adding a property through Obsidian Properties

Verify tags is pinned first, key_hidden is absent, key_bottom is last, and normal candidates are grouped as Text, List, Number, Checkbox, Date, Date & time, Tags when present, then Automatic / unspecified
Verify key_automatic appears under Automatic / unspecified because it exists in the Vault vocabulary but is deliberately absent from types.json
Navigate the visible candidates with Arrow keys, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown and Enter or touch; group labels must never become selectable stops or change the candidate count
Switch the inside-group sorter between Name, Recently used and Notes containing the property and verify type groups stay fixed while only members within a group reorder
Disable key suggestion enhancement, close and reopen the property-name editor, then verify native candidate order, visibility and selection behavior are restored without plugin group decoration
expected: The plugin reuses native candidate nodes and presents type labels without synthetic candidate rows
Hidden > pinned > grouped normal > bottom precedence is preserved and Automatic / unspecified is a normal non-error group
Keyboard and touch activation follow the final visible candidate order and never land on a visual group label
Disabling the feature or unloading the plugin restores native nodes, attributes, order and selection without stale type labels
The same scenario is checked on the minimum supported desktop host and the current supported desktop host; Android emulator verifies touch selection, rotation, narrow layout and cleanup
